vocals.method: Trained vocal separation with learned voice evidence, local source-energy articulation and periodic pitch tracking

timing.alignment: Separated vocal PCM clock; measured energy edges and estimated pitch; no lyric or word alignment

diagnostics.limitations: Separation bleed, layered voices, distortion, unvoiced consonants and rapid pitch changes can remain ambiguous. Pitch follows a dominant periodic voice, not every harmony. Articulation markers are not transcribed words.

Low-register harmonic estimates can include piano, low voice or tuned sustained drums. Brief or sweeping kick transients are suppressed; overlapping instruments, glides and quiet bass can be missed. Kicks overlapping a low note can still move its estimated boundary; the 5 ms boundary grid is not an accuracy guarantee.
diagnostics.boundaryMethod: Exact-frequency harmonic amplitudes in local PCM

limitations: Bass notes are estimated from combined accompaniment, not an isolated bass instrument.

roleAnalysis.vocalSource: Separated vocal waveform with singing and speech evidence
